description: The Kunstmuseum, Berlage's yellow-brick museum on Stadhouderslaan, sits beyond two long reflecting ponds and a glass-covered walk. The wings are low and horizontal. The sky is overcast, about 14.7°C, with wind near 7.6 km/h. The museum is closed. This building was called the Gemeentemuseum until 2019.
